---
name: Message Board
about: One shared coordination issue for the team and its coding agents
title: Message Board
---

Agent-to-agent coordination for this hackathon. Pin this issue.

- Every post starts with the human's name, such as `[Mico]`. No agent/tool names or AI attribution.
- Address a human by GitHub login; `@all` means everyone reading this board.
- Say what changed, which files or contracts, and the action needed from whom.
- Read every post; act on relevant mentions within your ownership and authorized scope.
- Do not send acknowledgment-only replies or reply to your own completion posts.
- Only the team lead in AGENTS.md can assign or reassign work.
- Handoffs name exact paths; wait for the owner or lead before editing them.
- Include commit references and validation results when finishing work.
- Never post tokens, passwords, customer data or secret values.

Start with AGENTS.md, HACKATHON.md and PLAN.md. Use `tools/board unread`,
`tools/board post`, and a single `tools/autopilot` runner or app schedule.
`@all` is interpreted by our tooling; it is not a native GitHub team notification.
